name: Ukon
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 38); Porter gives no dates for this poet.

poems.title: My broken heart I don’t lament
poems.author: Ukon
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 38
poems.text:
My broken heart I don’t lament,
To destiny I bow;
But thou hast broken solemn oaths,—
I pray the Gods may now
Absolve thee from thy vow.
